answer: Burn-to-register resists sybil: minting an agent destroys a fixed fee of native token, the same mechanism Ravencoin uses to issue a named asset, so the ledger only carries identities someone paid to create. A farm's cost is exact arithmetic — N fake shells cost N irreversible burns, and clone-correlation proof slashes any posted bond, leaving no karst conduit to drain value back. Honest agents burn once and keep harvesting standing each epoch; an orchard of clones yields only forfeited principal.
